passages.text: Now when Jabin king of Hazor heard about these things, he sent word to Jobab king of Madon; to the kings of Shimron and Achshaph; to the kings of the north in the mountains, in the Arabah south of Chinnereth, in the foothills, and in Naphoth-dor to the west; to the Canaanites in the east and west; to the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, and Jebusites in the hill country; and to the Hivites at the foot of Hermon in the land of Mizpah.
passages.sermon:
Jabin was the king of Hazor.
Jabin heard about these things.
Jabin sent word to Jobab.
Jobab was the king of Madon.
Jabin also sent word to the king of Shimron.
Jabin sent word to the king of Achshaph.
Jabin sent word to the kings in the north.
These kings lived in the mountains.
Some kings lived in the Arabah, south of Chinnereth.
Some kings lived in the foothills.
Some kings lived in Naphoth-dor, to the west.
Jabin sent word to the Canaanites in the east.
Jabin sent word to the Canaanites in the west.
Jabin sent word to the Amorites in the hill country.
Jabin sent word to the Hittites in the hill country.
Jabin sent word to the Perizzites in the hill country.
Jabin sent word to the Jebusites in the hill country.
Jabin sent word to the Hivites.
The Hivites lived at the foot of Hermon.
The Hivites lived in the land of Mizpah.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֕י כִּשְׁמֹ֖עַ יָבִ֣ין מֶֽלֶךְ־ חָצ֑וֹר וַיִּשְׁלַ֗ח אֶל־ יוֹבָב֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מָד֔וֹן וְאֶל־ מֶ֥לֶךְ שִׁמְר֖וֹן וְאֶל־ מֶ֥לֶךְ אַכְשָֽׁף׃ וְֽאֶל־ הַמְּלָכִ֞ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר מִצְּפ֗וֹן בָּהָ֧ר וּבָעֲרָבָ֛ה נֶ֥גֶב כִּֽנֲר֖וֹת וּבַשְּׁפֵלָ֑ה וּבְנָפ֥וֹת דּ֖וֹר מִיָּֽם׃ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ מִמִּזְרָ֣ח וּמִיָּ֔ם וְהָאֱמֹרִ֧י וְהַחִתִּ֛י וְהַפְּרִזִּ֥י וְהַיְבוּסִ֖י בָּהָ֑ר וְהַֽחִוִּי֙ תַּ֣חַת חֶרְמ֔וֹן בְּאֶ֖רֶץ הַמִּצְפָּֽה׃

passages.text: So these kings came out with all their armies, a multitude as numerous as the sand on the seashore, along with a great number of horses and chariots.
passages.sermon:
Many kings gathered together.
They brought all their armies with them.
Their people were very many.
They were as numerous as the sand on the seashore.
They also brought many horses.
They brought many chariots.
passages.original: וַיֵּצְא֣וּ הֵ֗ם וְכָל־ מַֽחֲנֵיהֶם֙ עִמָּ֔ם עַם־ רָ֕ב כַּח֛וֹל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־ שְׂפַת־ הַיָּ֖ם לָרֹ֑ב וְס֥וּס וָרֶ֖כֶב רַב־ מְאֹֽד׃

passages.text: All these kings joined forces and encamped at the waters of Merom to fight against Israel.
passages.sermon:
Many kings ruled the land of Canaan.
These kings heard about Israel.
These kings decided to join together.
They made an alliance.
They gathered their armies.
They marched to the waters of Merom.
They set up camp there.
They wanted to fight against Israel.
passages.original: וַיִּוָּ֣עֲד֔וּ כֹּ֖ל הַמְּלָכִ֣ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ וַיַּחֲנ֤וּ יַחְדָּו֙ אֶל־ מֵ֣י מֵר֔וֹם לְהִלָּחֵ֖ם עִם־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

passages.text: Then the LORD said to Joshua, “Do not be afraid of them, for by this time tomorrow I will deliver all of them slain before Israel. You are to hamstring their horses and burn up their chariots.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Joshua.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD said, “Do not be afraid of them.”
The LORD referred to the kings and their armies who gathered to fight Israel.
The LORD said, “By this time tomorrow, I will give all of them into Israel’s hand.”
The LORD said, “They will all be slain before Israel.”
The LORD commanded Joshua, “Hamstring their horses.”
The LORD commanded Joshua, “Burn their chariots with fire.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֣ה אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ֮ אַל־ תִּירָ֣א מִפְּנֵיהֶם֒ כִּֽי־ מָחָ֞ר כָּעֵ֣ת הַזֹּ֗את אָנֹכִ֞י נֹתֵ֧ן אֶת־ כֻּלָּ֛ם חֲלָלִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֶת־ סוּסֵיהֶ֣ם תְּעַקֵּ֔ר וְאֶת־ מַרְכְּבֹתֵיהֶ֖ם תִּשְׂרֹ֥ף בָּאֵֽשׁ׃

passages.text: So by the waters of Merom, Joshua and his whole army came upon them suddenly and attacked them, and the LORD delivered them into the hand of Israel, who struck them down and pursued them all the way to Greater Sidon and Misrephoth-maim, and eastward as far as the Valley of Mizpeh. They struck them down, leaving no survivors.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel’s army.
Joshua and all the warriors with him marched to the waters of Merom.
They came upon the enemy kings and their armies suddenly.
Joshua and his army attacked them.
The LORD gave the enemy armies into the hand of Israel.
Israel struck down the enemy armies.
Israel chased them as far as Greater Sidon.
Israel also pursued them to Misrephoth-maim.
Israel chased them eastward to the Valley of Mizpeh.
Israel struck down the enemy armies everywhere they went.
Israel left no survivors among the enemy.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֣א יְהוֹשֻׁ֡עַ וְכָל־ עַם֩ הַמִּלְחָמָ֨ה עִמּ֧וֹ עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם עַל־ מֵ֥י מֵר֖וֹם פִּתְאֹ֑ם וַֽיִּפְּל֖וּ בָּהֶֽם׃ וַיִּתְּנֵ֨ם יְהוָ֥ה בְּיַֽד־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ וַיַּכּוּם֒ וַֽיִּרְדְּפ֞וּם עַד־ צִיד֣וֹן רַבָּ֗ה וְעַד֙ מִשְׂרְפ֣וֹת מַ֔יִם וְעַד־ בִּקְעַ֥ת מִצְפֶּ֖ה מִזְרָ֑חָה וַיַּכֻּ֕ם עַד־ בִּלְתִּ֥י הִשְׁאִֽיר־ לָהֶ֖ם שָׂרִֽיד׃

passages.text: Joshua treated them as the LORD had told him; he hamstrung their horses and burned up their chariots.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel’s army.
The LORD gave Joshua a command.
Joshua obeyed the LORD.
Joshua hamstrung their horses.
Joshua burned their chariots with fire.
passages.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ לָהֶם֙ יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אָֽמַר־ ל֖וֹ יְהוָ֑ה אֶת־ סוּסֵיהֶ֣ם עִקֵּ֔ר וְאֶת־ מַרְכְּבֹתֵיהֶ֖ם שָׂרַ֥ף בָּאֵֽשׁ׃ס

passages.text: At that time Joshua turned back and captured Hazor and put its king to the sword, because Hazor was formerly the head of all these kingdoms.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel’s army.
At that time, Joshua turned back.
He captured the city of Hazor.
He killed the king of Hazor with the sword.
Hazor had been the chief city over all these kingdoms.
passages.original: וַיָּ֨שָׁב יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ בָּעֵ֤ת הַהִיא֙ וַיִּלְכֹּ֣ד אֶת־ חָצ֔וֹר וְאֶת־ מַלְכָּ֖הּ הִכָּ֣ה בֶחָ֑רֶב כִּֽי־ חָצ֣וֹר לְפָנִ֔ים הִ֕יא רֹ֖אשׁ כָּל־ הַמַּמְלָכ֥וֹת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

passages.text: The Israelites put everyone in Hazor to the sword, devoting them to destruction. Nothing that breathed remained, and Joshua burned down Hazor itself.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites attacked everyone in Hazor with the sword.
They killed every person in Hazor.
They devoted all the people to destruction.
No one who breathed remained alive in Hazor.
Joshua burned Hazor with fire.
passages.original: וַ֠יַּכּוּ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַנֶּ֨פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֤הּ לְפִי־ חֶ֙רֶב֙ הַֽחֲרֵ֔ם לֹ֥א נוֹתַ֖ר כָּל־ נְשָׁמָ֑ה וְאֶת־ חָצ֖וֹר שָׂרַ֥ף בָּאֵֽשׁ׃

passages.text: Joshua captured all these kings and their cities and put them to the sword. He devoted them to destruction, as Moses the LORD’s servant had commanded.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua captured all these cities.
These cities belonged to the kings.
Joshua captured all these kings.
Joshua struck the kings with the sword.
Joshua destroyed the kings and their cities completely.
Moses was the servant of the LORD.
Moses had commanded this destruction.
Joshua did as Moses commanded.
passages.original: וְֽאֶת־ כָּל־ עָרֵ֣י הַמְּלָכִֽים־ הָ֠אֵלֶּה וְֽאֶת־ כָּל־ מַלְכֵיהֶ֞ם לָכַ֧ד יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ וַיַּכֵּ֥ם לְפִי־ חֶ֖רֶב הֶחֱרִ֣ים אוֹתָ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֔ה מֹשֶׁ֖ה עֶ֥בֶד יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Yet Israel did not burn any of the cities built on their mounds, except Hazor, which Joshua burned.
passages.sermon:
Israel attacked many cities.
Some cities stood on their mounds.
Israel did not burn these cities.
Hazor was different.
Joshua burned Hazor.
Hazor was the only city on its mound that Joshua burned.
passages.original: רַ֣ק כָּל־ הֶעָרִ֗ים הָעֹֽמְדוֹת֙ עַל־ תִּלָּ֔ם לֹ֥א שְׂרָפָ֖ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל זוּלָתִ֛י אֶת־ חָצ֥וֹר לְבַדָּ֖הּ שָׂרַ֥ף יְהוֹשֻֽׁעַ׃

passages.text: The Israelites took for themselves all the plunder and livestock of these cities, but they put all the people to the sword until they had completely destroyed them, not sparing anyone who breathed.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites took all the plunder from these cities.
The Israelites took all the livestock from these cities.
The Israelites kept the plunder and livestock for themselves.
The Israelites killed all the people in these cities with the sword.
The Israelites destroyed all the people completely.
The Israelites did not spare anyone who was alive.
No one who breathed was left alive.
passages.original: וְ֠כֹל שְׁלַ֞ל הֶעָרִ֤ים הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ וְהַבְּהֵמָ֔ה בָּזְז֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רַ֣ק אֶֽת־ כָּל־ הָאָדָ֞ם הִכּ֣וּ לְפִי־ חֶ֗רֶב עַד־ הִשְׁמִדָם֙ אוֹתָ֔ם לֹ֥א הִשְׁאִ֖ירוּ כָּל־ נְשָׁמָֽה׃

passages.text: As the LORD had commanded His servant Moses, so Moses commanded Joshua. That is what Joshua did, leaving nothing undone of all that the LORD had commanded Moses.
passages.sermon:
The LORD gave commands to Moses, His servant.
Moses gave these same commands to Joshua.
Joshua obeyed all these commands.
Joshua did everything the LORD had commanded Moses.
Joshua did not leave anything undone.
passages.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֣ה עַבְדּ֔וֹ כֵּן־ צִוָּ֥ה מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶת־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ וְכֵן֙ עָשָׂ֣ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ לֹֽא־ הֵסִ֣יר דָּבָ֔ר מִכֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃

passages.text: So Joshua took this entire region: the hill country, all the Negev, all the land of Goshen, the western foothills, the Arabah, and the mountains of Israel and their foothills, from Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir, as far as Baal-gad in the Valley of Lebanon at the foot of Mount Hermon. He captured all their kings and struck them down, putting them to death.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of the Israelites.
Joshua took control of the whole land.
He took the hill country.
He took all the Negev.
He took all the land of Goshen.
He took the western foothills.
He took the Arabah.
He took the mountains of Israel.
He took the foothills of Israel.
He took land from Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir.
He took land as far as Baal-gad in the Valley of Lebanon.
Baal-gad is at the foot of Mount Hermon.
Joshua captured all the kings in these regions.
He struck down these kings.
He put these kings to death.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֗את הָהָ֤ר וְאֶת־ כָּל־ הַנֶּ֙גֶב֙ וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ אֶ֣רֶץ הַגֹּ֔שֶׁן וְאֶת־ הַשְּׁפֵלָ֖ה וְאֶת־ הָעֲרָבָ֑ה וְאֶת־ הַ֥ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וּשְׁפֵלָתֹֽה׃ מִן־ הָהָ֤ר הֶֽחָלָק֙ הָעוֹלֶ֣ה שֵׂעִ֔יר וְעַד־ בַּ֤עַל גָּד֙ בְּבִקְעַ֣ת הַלְּבָנ֔וֹן תַּ֖חַת הַר־ חֶרְמ֑וֹן וְאֵ֤ת כָּל־ מַלְכֵיהֶם֙ לָכַ֔ד וַיַּכֵּ֖ם וַיְמִיתֵֽם׃

passages.text: Joshua waged war against all these kings for a long period of time.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel after Moses.
Joshua fought against many kings.
Joshua waged war for a long time.
Joshua did not stop until the battles were finished.
passages.original: יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים עָשָׂ֧ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַמְּלָכִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה מִלְחָמָֽה׃

passages.text: No city made peace with the Israelites except the Hivites living in Gibeon; all others were taken in battle.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites were the people of Israel.
No city made peace with the Israelites.
Only the Hivites who lived in Gibeon made peace with them.
The Israelites took all the other cities in battle.
passages.original: לֹֽא־ הָיְתָ֣ה עִ֗יר אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִשְׁלִ֙ימָה֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בִּלְתִּ֥י הַחִוִּ֖י יֹשְׁבֵ֣י גִבְע֑וֹן אֶת־ הַכֹּ֖ל לָקְח֥וּ בַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃

passages.text: For it was of the LORD to harden their hearts to engage Israel in battle, so that they would be set apart for destruction and would receive no mercy, being annihilated as the LORD had commanded Moses.
passages.sermon:
The LORD acted with purpose.
The LORD made the hearts of these kings hard.
The LORD caused them to fight against Israel.
The LORD wanted them to be set apart for destruction.
The LORD did not allow them to receive mercy.
The LORD wanted them to be destroyed.
The LORD had commanded Moses to do this.
passages.original: כִּ֣י מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֣ה׀ הָיְתָ֡ה לְחַזֵּ֣ק אֶת־ לִבָּם֩ לִקְרַ֨את הַמִּלְחָמָ֤ה אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְמַ֣עַן הַֽחֲרִימָ֔ם לְבִלְתִּ֥י הֱיוֹת־ לָהֶ֖ם תְּחִנָּ֑ה כִּ֚י לְמַ֣עַן הַשְׁמִידָ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס

passages.text: At that time Joshua proceeded to eliminate the Anakim from the hill country of Hebron, Debir, and Anab, and from all the hill country of Judah and of Israel. Joshua devoted them to destruction, along with their cities.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
At that time, Joshua acted.
Joshua went to the hill country.
He went to Hebron.
He went to Debir.
He went to Anab.
He went to all the hill country of Judah.
He went to all the hill country of Israel.
The Anakim lived in these places.
Joshua eliminated the Anakim from these places.
Joshua destroyed their cities.
Joshua devoted the Anakim and their cities to destruction.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֨א יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֗יא וַיַּכְרֵ֤ת אֶת־ הָֽעֲנָקִים֙ מִן־ הָהָ֤ר מִן־ חֶבְרוֹן֙ מִן־ דְּבִ֣ר מִן־ עֲנָ֔ב וּמִכֹּל֙ הַ֣ר יְהוּדָ֔ה וּמִכֹּ֖ל הַ֣ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עִם־ עָרֵיהֶ֖ם הֶחֱרִימָ֥ם יְהוֹשֻֽׁעַ׃

passages.text: No Anakim were left in the land of the Israelites; only in Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod did any survive.
passages.sermon:
The Anakim were a people known for their great size and strength.
Joshua led the Israelites into the land of Canaan.
Joshua removed all the Anakim from the land of the Israelites.
No Anakim remained in the territory of Israel.
Some Anakim survived only in Gaza.
Some Anakim survived only in Gath.
Some Anakim survived only in Ashdod.
passages.original: לֹֽא־ נוֹתַ֣ר עֲנָקִ֔ים בְּאֶ֖רֶץ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רַ֗ק בְּעַזָּ֛ה בְּגַ֥ת וּבְאַשְׁדּ֖וֹד נִשְׁאָֽרוּ׃

passages.text: So Joshua took the entire land, in keeping with all that the LORD had spoken to Moses. And Joshua gave it as an inheritance to Israel according to the allotments to their tribes. Then the land had rest from war.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
God spoke to Moses about the land.
Joshua took all the land.
He did everything God had said to Moses.
Joshua gave the land to Israel.
He divided the land by tribes.
Each tribe received its share.
The land became peaceful.
There was no more war.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָאָ֗רֶץ כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָה֮ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁה֒ וַיִּתְּנָהּ֩ יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ לְנַחֲלָ֧ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל כְּמַחְלְקֹתָ֖ם לְשִׁבְטֵיהֶ֑ם וְהָאָ֥רֶץ שָׁקְטָ֖ה מִמִּלְחָמָֽה׃פ
